newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal non-tradable goods prices up 5.1 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Portugal non-tradable goods prices up 5.1 pct y/y.

text.p: Portuguese non-tradable goods prices rose 5.1 percent year-on-year in January against 5.0 percent in December, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Tuesday.
It attributed the increase to adjustments in electricity and fuel prices. Tradable goods prices rose 1.8 percent, unchanged on the previous month.
INE released the overall consumer price index (CPI) on Monday showing overall year-on-year inflation steady at 3.3 percent.

It said factory gate prices for manufactured goods other than food and petrol derivatives rose 0.8 percent year-on-year in the three months to November, similar to the change recorded in the third quarter of 1996. --Lisbon bureau 3511-315035
